title: Detector operating characteristic: lag, lead, misses, false alarms

config.drift_rate_def: probability that a given write is newly-incompressible (one op == one write), i.e. the drift's share of the write stream; 1.0 reproduces E3's whole-working-set rewrite, 0.0 is the stationary control
config.ratio_detector: fast/slow EWMA ratio > threshold, sampled every op; TRANSIENT (clears once the slow EWMA absorbs the shift)
config.cusum_detector: S+ = max(0, S+ + (x - mu_slow - 0.5*sigma_slow)), alarm at S+ > h*sigma_slow, sigma floored at 32 B; LATCHES. The device runs h=5; the recorded size stream is replayed offline over CUSUM_H so the detector gets an operating characteristic rather than a single point.
config.false_alarm_def: an alarm raised during the stationary pre-drift phase, which begins after the working set is laid down and the detector is armed; alarms during the layup are warm-up transients, not false alarms on stationary content, and are excluded. Policy re-arms after acting, so a run can have several
config.false_positive_window: the stationary pre-drift phase of every run plus the drift_rate=0 control arm
